headline: Bank of England Hikes Interest Rates, Warns of Further Tightening
summary: The Bank of England raised interest rates for the first time since 2023 and signaled further hikes may follow, warning that UK inflation could hit approximately 5% by mid-2027.
why: The Bank of England's policy rate dictates sterling credit conditions and UK gilt yields, directly impacting global bond markets and multinational borrowing costs.

impacts.name: Bank of England Policy Rate
impacts.why: Bank of England raised its benchmark policy rate to counter accelerating inflation.
